svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Editor tab · Crop · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift — the grading editor in its own resizable window (PhotoEditorWindowRequest scene in LetsLapseApp; default 1000×700 drawn here, min 720×480; the window chrome owns title and close, so there is no in-content back button or Done bar). REBUILT 2026-09-13 around the editor-controls redesign (Claude Design handoff “LetsLapse Editor slider organization”, boards 3b · 6c; spec sections 1–5, 9, 10): the seven-section always-open panel is gone; the grade is five GROUPS + Presets (App/EditorControls/EditorGroup.swift — Light: Exp · Con / High · Wh / Shad · Bl; Color: WB / Vib · Sat / Mixer; Effects: Tex · Clar / Vignette / Dehaze; Detail: Sharpen / Noise; Crop: aspect chips + Angle), each opened from a main button into ONE card of tool chips over an XY PAD (App/EditorControls/XYPad.swift) with two readouts, and closed by Revert (restores the snapshot taken when the panel opened) or Done (keeps). THIS FILE: the CROP group (spec §10, decision 3) on the interval shoot — the one group with no tool chips. CARD: header (“Crop”, no dot and no Reset while the crop is Original and the angle 0 — the crop and the level are geometry and never move the Original / Edited pill), Revert, Done; the ASPECT CHIPS Original · 1:1 · 4:5 · 16:9 · 9:16 · Custom — six equal chips 4 apart, 10.5 pt semibold, padding 5 vertical, radius 6, a 1 pt black-8 % hairline, idle fill #F2F2F7, the chosen one LL.accent with white text; the HINT under them, 11 pt #6D6D72 — “Original · the whole picture” / “Locked to 16:9 · drag to move, pinch or drag a corner to scale” / “Free crop · drag corners, drag to move, pinch to scale”; then ANGLE — the shared RotationSlider (App/RotationSlider.swift, .stacked): 13.5 pt label, “0°” readout (secondary at 0, black once moved, accent with a ◆ when keyframed), the native Slider ±10° resting at centre (grey track, 20 pt white knob — NSSlider draws no accent fill), double-click the label to zero; and its tertiary 11 pt footnote (“Levels the picture and crops in so no corner shows black. Baked into blended and guided clips; set it at more than one moment and it eases between them.”). CROP MODEL: PhotoAdjustments.crop is a FrameCrop — a normalized rect in the LEVELLED frame's unit square plus an aspect — STATIC, carried whole by the timeline like hsl / lut (held from the earlier keyframe, never blended), out of presets and out of the Original / Edited verdict, encoded only when set. Original = no crop; a ratio = the largest centred frame of that shape (FrameCrop.fitted); Custom keeps the rectangle and frees its ratio. THE PICTURE IS NEVER RESIZED by the crop: CropFrameOverlay draws a scrim and a frame OVER the full picture so zoom, 1:1, text layers and masks keep their coordinate spaces — panel open: 55 % scrim outside the crop, a 1 pt white-90 % frame, rule-of-thirds hairlines white 35 % inside, four L-brackets (18 pt arms, 3 pt white) on 36 pt corner hit areas; drag the body to move, drag a corner to resize about the opposite corner (locked ratios stay locked), pinch to scale about the centre; panel closed and a crop set: an 85 % scrim and the frame, nothing interactive. Drawn here on ORIGINAL, so the frame is the whole picture — the brackets sit on the pane's own corners and the scrim covers nothing. Opening Crop fits the picture (zoom reset) so the frame and its handles are all on screen. Export honours the crop on the still path (FrameCrop.apply after the level); paths that cannot are listed in docs/TODO.md. TIMELINE (6c): with the Editor tab up on an interval shoot the strip leaves the rail and takes a 54 pt row under the media pane — padding 6 top / 16 sides, GradeTimelineView on its COMPACT metrics (26 pt play disc, 12 pt gap, 3 pt rail at primary 18 %, 11 pt moments with the 2 pt #C36A00 ring, 3×20 playhead in #1C1C1E drawn UNDER the moments, the elapsed bubble 8 pt above the row, 10 pt h:mm:ss end labels 2 pt under the track row) and the two 26 pt frame steps 6 apart at the right; on the light surface the discs are #E9E9EB with accent glyphs and the bubble is white with a shadow and black text. Track x=74…609. The INTERVAL badge (EditorMarqueeBadge — kind · length · frame count, 20 pt, black 50 %, 11 pt semibold) sits bottom-left of the pane at (12, 12). Staged by LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset: three owned-white moments at 10 / 52 / 86 % (6100 K / 7600 K / 5400 K with Exposure 0 / −0.20 / −0.50, Highlights −0.20 / −0.35 / −0.10, Shadows +0.10 / +0.18 / +0.30, Vibrance +0.12 / +0.38 / +0.10), the playhead at 30 % — so the keyframed fields are whiteMired, exposure, highlights, shadows and vibrance, and the values under the playhead are the eased blend of the first two moments (6715 K, Exposure −0.09, Highlights −27). The clock strings drawn (0:40:12, 2:14:00, 2 h 14 min · 58 frames) are the board's sample data; the 2026-09-13 captures ran on the bench shoot “Stack 2. 9. at 21:03” (1 h 34 min · 5660 frames, playhead 0:28:18). RAIL (3b / 6c): a FIXED 330 pt rail (railWidth, macOS) right of a hairline Divider — resizing the window grows the picture, never the controls. On the Editor page the whole rail scrolls, tab pill included: padding 14 top / 16 sides / 20 bottom, 12 between items. Top to bottom: (1) RailTabBar as a white capsule (padding 3, equal segments 2 apart, 13 pt semibold, the selected segment LL.accent with a white label) — Editor · Text · Frames · Masks, Frames only where frames do (availableRailTabs); (2) EditorGroupBar .macCard — a white card padded 6 holding six 46 pt cells spread edge to edge: 18 pt SF Symbol (photo.stack, sun.max, circle.lefthalf.filled, sparkles, triangle, crop.rotate), 9.5 pt semibold label, a 4 pt dot lit when the group holds a value or a travelling field, idle ink #6D6D72, the OPEN group on LL.accent 12 % with accent ink; a tap opens that group's panel and snapshots the grade, a tap on the open group leaves it open — closing is the panel's Revert / Done; (3) the open group's PhotoAdjustmentsPanel as a white radius-12 card padded 12 with 10 between rows: the header (title 13.5 semibold #6D6D72, the 6 pt dot when non-neutral, then Reset in accent text while non-neutral, the Revert pill #E9E9EB and the Done pill LL.accent, both 12 pt semibold, 23 tall, radius 7 — Done keeps the values and drops the snapshot, Revert restores it, both close), then the group's content; (4) MasksCard on its compact rows; (5) “Reset adjustments” 13 pt semibold accent, 4 in from the rail's content edge — and nothing after it: the inline “Save these edits as a preset?” offer lives in the Presets card's footer alone since 2026-09-13 (photo-viewer.presets.svg); the rail foot that used to repeat it is gone. Group card 62 tall at y=110; the panel card starts at y=184. CHIP ROW (fixed 2026-09-13): the light-style chips keep 10.5 pt semibold but carry 2 pt of side padding inside the label and `minimumScaleFactor(0.8)`, so “Original” and “Custom” shrink a hair rather than run to their chip's edge, and the six chips sit inside 718…992 as drawn (the 2026-09-13 capture mac-crop-rail-crop.png had them overflowing; mac-crop-v2.png matches this file). DEVIATIONS drawn as shipped: the header's Reset text button (absent here because the group is neutral); the Angle track has no accent fill (native). STATES NOT DRAWN (desc-only): a locked ratio (the frame inset with the scrim outside — the brackets then sit inside the picture); Custom; a levelled picture (rotated about its centre and cropped in to the largest same-aspect rectangle, FrameRotation.inscribedScale, so no corner is black); the closed-panel 85 % scrim. Hooks: LL_EDITOR=latest LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=crop. Verified 2026-09-13 against the running Debug build (chips, hint, Angle, footnote, frame + thirds + brackets on the picture).
